commitMessage:
Consent gate works for read-only accounts; readable error message

A read-only account (user or server 'Hanya-baca') may only change the
'termsAccepted' attribute of its own account, so saving the consent
record failed with a Java stack trace. The gate now retries with
termsAccepted only and keeps the detailed record (version, time, items)
in the browser; Consents and Users show such accounts as 'Setuju
(hanya-baca)'. Server errors are shortened to their first line.

Docs updated (legal, limits, change history), including the hash of the
docs commit.
